head.name: @fzlt/core/sound
head.lead: The sound adapter. After each frame it reads the engine's event ring and plays the mapped cues, so collisions and game events make sound without knowing about audio. The default voice is a tiny synth (oscillators, no assets); pass play to use your own sounds. Silent until the first trusted gesture, while paused, and when switched off.
